root_cause.text: In nfulnl_log_packet(), the size calculation for the NLMSG_DONE message incorrectly used `nla_total_size()` (which only accounts for the attribute payload and header) instead of `nlmsg_total_size()` (which also includes the netlink message header), resulting in an underestimation of the required buffer size that can trigger a WARN splat and drop of the netlink message.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `nla_total_size(sizeof(struct nfgenmsg))` to `nlmsg_total_size(sizeof(struct nfgenmsg))` for the NLMSG_DONE size component. The commit message explicitly states: "NLMSG_DONE needs to account for the netlink header size, not just the attribute size." This confirms the prior omission of the netlink header in the size budget.
